model: XGBoost, hybrid features (13) incl. VAAF and TGI
tolerance_rule: Strict tolerance on the reference platform (Linux: the baseline came from Google Colab and the Docker image is Linux). On other platforms the XGBoost build is not bit-identical, so the primary metric may differ by up to 0.01 (the brief's recommended maximum). Split identity checks stay exact everywhere.
scale_pos_weight_origin: train counts of an earlier 0.30 stratified split (2113 neg / 172 pos)
source: NEWCOLUMNS_StrokeRiskPrediction_XGBOOST_MODELING.ipynb; ids hashes derived by applying the notebook's split to the group's Engineered2.csv
